question: A car travels the first 180 km at a speed of 20 km/h. It covers the next 210 km at a speed of 35 km/h. Find the average speed of the car (in km/h).
solution:
**Given:-**

(1) First segment: Distance = 180 km, Speed = 20 km/h

(2) Second segment: Distance = 210 km, Speed = 35 km/h

**Formula used:- **

 

(1) Time = Distance / Speed 

(2) Average Speed = Total Distance / Total Time

Calculation:-&nbs
